executiveComp.source: Not verified — check Form 990 Schedule J Parts I-III for Hackensack Meridian Health Inc. (EIN 22-1601338). Robert C. Garrett has served as CEO since the 2016 merger (previously CEO of Hackensack University Health Network). Garrett's total compensation has been widely reported by Becker's Hospital Review and NJ media as among the highest for nonprofit hospital CEOs in New Jersey. Compensation is reported as being paid primarily through related organizations rather than the filing entity. Verify NJ state average community benefit percentage from NJ DHSS Hospital Performance Report.

taxAdvantage.notes: Hackensack Meridian Health operates 18 hospitals and 500+ care locations across New Jersey, all property-tax-exempt. NJ has a 9% corporate business tax rate (11.5% surcharge for income over $1M). Bond debt is issued through the NJ Health Care Facilities Financing Authority generating substantial tax-exempt interest subsidies. Multiple HMH hospitals qualify as DSH for 340B program participation. NJ has a 6.625% sales and use tax from which HMH is exempt on qualifying purchases.

keyRiskFactors: Post-merger integration of multiple legacy hospital systems across diverse NJ markets
High labor costs in the northern New Jersey and New York metropolitan market
Geographic concentration in a single state (New Jersey)
Competition from large academic medical centers in New York City for specialty and tertiary services
Thin operating margins typical of NJ hospital market
